comment: The section suggests that the reference architecture can be used as a common benchmark regardless of whether a national architecture was developed from it. This may be difficult where the national architecture uses different component boundaries, modelling languages, or terminology.

anchor.note: p.79 l.Lines 965-980 read as the printed page; section 3.7.1 agrees

public.text: The section suggests that the reference architecture can be used as a common benchmark regardless of whether a national architecture was developed from it. This may be difficult where the national architecture uses different component boundaries, modelling languages, or terminology.
public.suggestedRevision: Define a formal mapping method that allows national elements expressed in other frameworks or modelling languages to be mapped to the reference architecture without requiring complete remodelling in ArchiMate.
